problem_statement: codrops/ParticleEffectsButtons (rebranded here as Emberkit) is a single-page static demo: a showcase gallery of twelve buttons (Send, Upload, Delete, Submit, refresh, Bookmark, Subscribe, Logout, Add to cart, Pause, Register, Export) that each burst into particles on a per-button canvas, driven by particles.js + anime.js with a rewind restore control. Today the twelve bursts are just dropped into one long scroll gallery with no way to browse them by the kind of action they belong to. Build Emberkit's own 'Button library' finder ABOVE the gallery: a category chip row (All bursts / Messaging / Files / Account / Commerce, each showing its count) over a compact card grid of the twelve real buttons (each card shows the button label, its theme swatch and its category tag), plus a live readout of the form 'Showing N of 12 · <Category>'. Clicking a category chip must re-filter the cards to that category and update the readout count; the All bursts chip restores all twelve. The finder is the product's own browsing control, so it must render on BOTH the Buttons home page and the cross-page 'Particle Sequence Rehearsal' page (/rehearsal.html, reachable from the shared Emberkit nav) using the SAME shared design system -- the same masthead shell, the same .site-nav navigation, and the same finder component -- so the browsing experience stays consistent across the two surfaces. The chip row must wrap and stay legible with no horizontal overflow on a narrow screen, the cards must not overlap, and the active chip and card text must remain readable. The reference filters correctly, keeps the finder on both pages, and reflows cleanly on mobile; a broken submission mis-lays-out the finder (chips and cards collide into an illegible pile), overflows on mobile, drops the finder from the rehearsal page, or leaves the readout/count frozen so clicking a chip changes nothing.
required_content: A 'Button library' finder heading and a live readout 'Showing 12 of 12 · All bursts' on the home page.
A category chip row: All bursts, Messaging, Files, Account, Commerce, each with its count.
A card grid of all twelve real buttons (Send … Export), each with its theme swatch and category tag.
Clicking the Commerce chip filters to the three Commerce buttons (Delete, Submit, Add to cart) and updates the readout to 'Showing 3 of 12 · Commerce'.
The same finder rendered on the cross-page /rehearsal.html surface via the shared Emberkit nav and design system.
No horizontal overflow on mobile; chips wrap and cards stay legible and non-overlapping.
design_constraints: Reuse the Emberkit shared design system (masthead shell, .site-nav, Montserrat type, gold #f4bf3f accent) for the finder.
Do not remove or restyle the original twelve particle buttons, their per-button particles.js canvases, or the rewind restore control.
The finder must be a real filter control: clicking a category chip re-filters the twelve button cards and updates a live 'Showing N of 12' readout, not a static list.
The finder card swatches must reuse the repo's own twelve theme-N gradients and the real button labels (Send … Export).
Render the finder on both the Buttons home page and the /rehearsal.html page so the browsing experience stays consistent across surfaces.
state_constraints: desktop_home renders the Emberkit masthead and the Button library finder above the particle gallery.
desktop_finder shows the finder scrolled into view with all twelve button cards and the five category chips.
desktop_finder_commerce is desktop_finder after clicking the Commerce chip: exactly three cards and readout 'Showing 3 of 12 · Commerce'.
desktop_rehearsal renders the shared Emberkit nav, the rehearsal step cards, and the same Button library finder.
mobile_home and mobile_rehearsal show no horizontal overflow with the chip row wrapped.

change_completion: The Button library finder renders on the home page with the heading, five category chips (with counts) and all twelve button cards.
Clicking the Commerce chip filters to three cards and the readout reads 'Showing 3 of 12 · Commerce'; All bursts restores twelve.
design_consistency: The finder uses the Emberkit shared design system and appears on both the home and /rehearsal pages via the shared nav.
The active chip, card names and category tags stay legible (no dark-on-dark or white-on-white) against the Emberkit palette.
responsive: On a mobile viewport the chip row wraps and the finder produces no horizontal overflow beyond tolerance.
The card grid reflows to fewer columns on narrow screens without cards overlapping.
regression: No regression: the original twelve particle buttons (Send, Upload, Add to cart, …) and their per-button canvases still render unchanged below the finder.
No regression in the masthead, GitHub link, rewind restore control, or the particles.js/anime.js burst behaviour, and no new console errors are introduced.

author_notes: Native-lever rebuild for the codrops ParticleEffectsButtons / Emberkit particle-button showcase. The lever is the gallery's own category filter: a Button library finder (chip row + card grid + live count readout) over the twelve real buttons and their theme swatches, rendered on the home page and the cross-page rehearsal page. Graded surfaces are the finder stylesheet css/finder.css (responsive chip-row wrap + non-overlapping card grid layout), the filter wiring js/finder.js (live readout + real card filtering), and the cross-page presence of the finder section. Reference screenshots show the finder card grid with swatches and category tags; the SVG icons under img/rehearsal/ and the button theme swatch images/gradients are the visual assets. The interactive canvas particle bursts and rewind controls are preserved.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: Unused static Codrops particle-button canvas demo with a shared masthead + nav and a natural single-page gap: it has no place that walks through composing a burst sequence, so a new shared-design-system Rehearsal page registered in the shared nav is a clean cross-page consistency add authored independently of the canvas.
